stages.name: Seedling
stages.line: A small thanks, written down, is enough to begin.

stages.name: Herb
stages.line: Noticed again, the small thanks puts out leaves.

stages.name: Deciduous Tree
stages.line: Kept over many days, gratitude grows shade for other people.

stages.name: Red Apple
stages.line: What you tended feeds someone who did not plant it.

stages.name: Egg
stages.line: Something waits inside a quiet thanks, not yet seen.

stages.name: Hatching Chick
stages.line: Say it a few days in a row and it cracks open.

stages.name: Baby Chick
stages.line: Young gratitude follows you around, asking to be fed.

stages.name: Rooster
stages.line: Grown, it wakes the whole house before the light.

stages.name: New Moon
stages.line: Some gratitude starts dark, a shape you trust is there.

stages.name: Waxing Crescent
stages.line: A thin edge of light shows after a few evenings.

stages.name: First Quarter
stages.line: Half lit now, and you can read by it.

stages.name: Waxing Gibbous
stages.line: Nearly whole, the thanks lights the path home.

stages.name: Full Moon
stages.line: Full, it needs no lamp to be seen by.

stages.name: Cloud
stages.line: A heavy day still holds water something needs.

stages.name: Rain Cloud
stages.line: Let it fall; the ground has been waiting.

stages.name: Sun Behind Rain
stages.line: Light and rain at once, in the same sky.

stages.name: Rainbow
stages.line: What was heavy shows its colors when the light returns.

stages.name: Candle
stages.line: One small flame is enough to see the next step.

stages.name: Fire
stages.line: Fed each day, the flame becomes warmth to sit by.

stages.name: Sparkles
stages.line: The warmth throws off light you did not plan.

stages.name: Glowing Star
stages.line: Steady light, seen from far away by people you have not met.

stages.name: Droplet
stages.line: One drop of thanks is small and completely real.

stages.name: Droplets
stages.line: A few drops together begin to sound like rain.

stages.name: Water Wave
stages.line: Enough drops make a wave that moves on its own.

stages.name: Spouting Whale
stages.line: Deep water holds something vast and gentle that surfaces to breathe.

stages.name: White Heart
stages.line: A plain heart, open, before it has a color.

stages.name: Beating Heart
stages.line: Tended, it starts to keep time with your days.

stages.name: Growing Heart
stages.line: Each day of thanks makes room for one more.

stages.name: Sparkling Heart
stages.line: A full heart throws light on everything nearby.

stages.name: Revolving Hearts
stages.line: Two hearts turning around each other, both kept in motion.

stages.name: Chestnut
stages.line: A hard shell keeps something soft and whole for later.

stages.name: Chipmunk
stages.line: What you tuck away on tired days is not lost.

stages.name: Evergreen Tree
stages.line: The kept thing grows into a tree that stays green through winter.

stages.name: Bug
stages.line: The small thing you flinch from is only eating leaves.

stages.name: Butterfly
stages.line: Looked at long enough, it grows wings and lifts.

stages.name: Cherry Blossom
stages.line: It lands on a branch and the branch flowers.

stages.name: Sunrise
stages.line: Morning thanks faces the horizon before anything has happened.

stages.name: Sun
stages.line: By midday the light is on everything, plain and warm.

stages.name: Sunset
stages.line: Evening thanks looks back over a day that held.

stages.name: Night With Stars
stages.line: Night comes and the city keeps its small lights on.

stages.name: Musical Note
stages.line: One note of thanks, clear, and then quiet.

stages.name: Musical Notes
stages.line: A few notes in a row start to sound like a tune.

stages.name: Sheet Music
stages.line: Written down, the tune can be played again tomorrow.

stages.name: Violin
stages.line: Practiced, the tune becomes an instrument someone else can hear.

stages.name: Hot Beverage
stages.line: A warm cup held in both hands is a whole thanks.

stages.name: Croissant
stages.line: Something small and good to go with it.

stages.name: Newspaper
stages.line: The morning widens to include the world, slowly.

stages.name: Couch And Lamp
stages.line: Rest has a place to sit and a lamp beside it.

stages.name: Open Book
stages.line: An open page holds what you did not know yet.

stages.name: Books
stages.line: Read a little each day and the shelf fills.

stages.name: Graduation Cap
stages.line: What frightened you once, you can now explain to someone.

stages.name: Owl
stages.line: You see well in the dark now, and you wait.

stages.name: House
stages.line: Thanks for a roof is thanks for the ordinary.

stages.name: House With Garden
stages.line: Tended, a house grows a garden around it.

stages.name: Houses
stages.line: One warm house makes the whole street feel lived in.

stages.name: Handshake
stages.line: A hand offered and a hand taken: the first pattern.

stages.name: Two People
stages.line: Two people who keep showing up become a pair.

stages.name: People Hugging
stages.line: Held close, thanks needs no words at all.

stages.name: Globe
stages.line: Enough hands held and the world is smaller and kinder.

stages.name: Bread
stages.line: Plain bread, warm, is the oldest thanks there is.

stages.name: Sandwich
stages.line: Bread made for someone is bread with a name on it.

stages.name: Basket
stages.line: Packed and carried, the meal goes where people are.

stages.name: Place Setting
stages.line: A set table is a thanks said before anyone eats.

stages.name: Person Meditating
stages.line: Sitting still is a way of saying thank you for now.

stages.name: Wind Face
stages.line: One long breath out, and the room is larger.

stages.name: Fog
stages.line: Fog is not nothing; it is the day being soft.

stages.name: Sun Behind Cloud
stages.line: The fog lifts on its own and the light comes through.

stages.name: Person Walking
stages.line: Heat in the chest goes into the feet, one step.

stages.name: Hiking Boot
stages.line: Good boots turn a hard mood into a long walk.

stages.name: Mountain
stages.line: From high up the thing looks small and far.

stages.name: Mountain Sunrise
stages.line: You walked far enough that the morning found you.

stages.name: Artist Palette
stages.line: Color set out, before you know what it will be.

stages.name: Paintbrush
stages.line: A few days in, the brush knows where to go.

stages.name: Framed Picture
stages.line: Finished and hung, the thanks is there for anyone to see.

stages.name: Pencil
stages.line: A pencil is enough to put the heavy thing down.

stages.name: Memo
stages.line: A few lines on a hard day are still lines.

stages.name: Page
stages.line: The page fills, and the weight is on the paper now.

stages.name: Scroll
stages.line: Days of pages become a record you can unroll.

stages.name: Closed Book
stages.line: Closed, it holds everything and asks nothing of you.

stages.name: Thread
stages.line: A single thread is thin and still holds a stitch.

stages.name: Sewing Needle
stages.line: Each day the needle goes through and pulls the pieces closer.

stages.name: Scarf
stages.line: Stitch by stitch, warmth for the cold part of the year.

stages.name: Coat
stages.line: Mended long enough, it becomes a coat you can give away.

stages.name: Rock
stages.line: Anger, held still, becomes a rock you can stand on.

stages.name: Brick
stages.line: Shaped by a day, the rock becomes something that fits.

stages.name: Construction
stages.line: Brick on brick, the heat is building something now.

stages.name: Castle
stages.line: Walls made from old anger keep a warm room inside.

stages.name: Sheaf Of Rice
stages.line: A whole season stands in the field, ready to be cut.

stages.name: Cooked Rice
stages.line: Plain rice in a bowl is enough for a tired night.

stages.name: Rice Ball
stages.line: Shaped by hand, the meal is made to be carried.

stages.name: Bento Box
stages.line: Packed with care, rest travels with you into the day.

stages.name: Grapes
stages.line: Grapes take a whole summer, and nobody hurries them.

stages.name: Wine Glass
stages.line: Time in the dark turns the harvest into something deeper.

stages.name: Clinking Glasses
stages.line: Poured for two, the long wait becomes a toast.

stages.name: Spiral Shell
stages.line: A shell is the thanks the sea leaves on the sand.

stages.name: Beach
stages.line: Sit long enough and the whole shore is yours.

stages.name: Sailboat
stages.line: The shore lets you go, and the wind does the rest.

stages.name: Dolphin
stages.line: Out past the shallows, something joyful swims beside the boat.

stages.name: Potted Plant
stages.line: A plant on the sill, watered, is love in a small pot.

stages.name: Tulip
stages.line: The first bloom opens on a morning you did not expect.

stages.name: Rose
stages.line: Kept close and tended, the bloom deepens in color.

stages.name: Bouquet
stages.line: Gathered, it becomes something you carry to a door.

stages.name: Compass
stages.line: A compass gives you north, not the whole road.

stages.name: World Map
stages.line: Named places begin to appear, one at a time.

stages.name: Luggage
stages.line: Packed light, you are ready before you feel ready.

stages.name: Airplane
stages.line: Lifted, the thanks goes somewhere you have not been.

stages.name: Far Side
stages.line: The far side of the world turns out to have mornings too.

stages.name: Hourglass
stages.line: Sand is falling, and that is all it has to do.

stages.name: Hourglass Done
stages.line: The sand is through; the hour is finished and kept.

stages.name: Mantel Clock
stages.line: Hours of rest add up on the mantel, quietly.

stages.name: Calendar
stages.line: Days of rest make a month you can look back on.

stages.name: Key
stages.line: You hold a key and the door is still shut.

stages.name: Open Lock
stages.line: Turned once, the lock lets go without a fight.

stages.name: Door
stages.line: An open door shows a room that was there the whole time.

stages.name: Road
stages.line: Past the door there is a road, and it is yours.

stages.name: Puzzle Piece
stages.line: One piece, no picture yet, and that is fine.

stages.name: Magnifying Glass
stages.line: Look closer at the worry and it has edges.

stages.name: Light Bulb
stages.line: The pieces meet and a small light comes on.

stages.name: Bullseye
stages.line: It fits; what unsettled you had a place all along.

stages.name: Mirror
stages.line: The mirror shows a tired face and does not lie.

stages.name: Window
stages.line: Turned outward, the same glass shows a street and weather.

stages.name: Telescope
stages.line: Looked at long enough, far things come near.

stages.name: Milky Way
stages.line: The sadness is real and the sky is very large.

stages.name: Balloon
stages.line: A balloon is a small joy held by a string.

stages.name: Party Popper
stages.line: A few days of joy start a small celebration.

stages.name: Birthday Cake
stages.line: Someone is being celebrated, and you are in the room.

stages.name: Wrapped Gift
stages.line: Joy, wrapped, wants to be handed to someone else.

stages.name: Brain
stages.line: Anger arrives as heat; the thinking comes after.

stages.name: Thought Balloon
stages.line: Given a day, the heat becomes a clear thought.

stages.name: Speech Balloon
stages.line: A clear thought can be said in plain words.

stages.name: Speaking Head
stages.line: Said out loud, calmly, it changes something.

stages.name: Snowflake
stages.line: One flake lands on the heat and hisses.

stages.name: Snow Cloud
stages.line: Enough cold and the whole sky turns to snow.

stages.name: Snowman
stages.line: The cooled anger gets a face and two stick arms.

stages.name: Sled
stages.line: What was heat is now a hill you can play on.

stages.name: Fallen Leaf
stages.line: Something has fallen, and it is allowed to lie there.

stages.name: Mushroom
stages.line: In the damp, small things begin to grow from it.

stages.name: Worm
stages.line: Underground, the loss is being turned into soil.

stages.name: Blossom
stages.line: From that soil, a flower you did not plant.

stages.name: Honeybee
stages.line: A sting is real, and so is the work.

stages.name: Hibiscus
stages.line: Worked at, the hot day finds a flower to visit.

stages.name: Honey Pot
stages.line: Enough visits and the heat has turned to sweetness.

stages.name: Bell
stages.line: A bell rings and asks you to answer.

stages.name: Folded Hands
stages.line: Answered with thanks, the call stops being a threat.

stages.name: Dove
stages.line: The answered bell sends something white out the window.

stages.name: Peace Symbol
stages.line: Quiet, after the ringing, that stays in the room.

stages.name: Sunflower
stages.line: A sunflower turns to face what it is grateful for.

stages.name: Sun With Face
stages.line: Faced long enough, the sun looks back and smiles.

stages.name: Bird
stages.line: In the end it feeds the birds with its seeds.

stages.name: Four Leaf Clover
stages.line: Luck is a thanks that arrives before you asked.

stages.name: Lady Beetle
stages.line: Small luck lands on your hand and stays a moment.

stages.name: Shooting Star
stages.line: Noticed often enough, luck becomes a sky you can wish on.

stages.name: Turtle
stages.line: Slow is still moving, and the shell is a home.

stages.name: Palm Tree
stages.line: Slowly, the shore comes, and there is shade on it.

stages.name: Desert Island
stages.line: Arrived, at your own pace, at a quiet place to rest.
